verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair axis for a coding agent, but the evidence shows no native scheduler, cron trigger, or recurring-task feature in Codex. The docs only say codex exec can be called from repeatable workflows, scripts, and CI pipelines, so any schedule would come from external CI or cron. That is a developer building block or user-side workaround, not a recurring schedule the product itself provides. One-off delegation ("Delegate a longer task and return when it is ready") is not a recurring schedule. missing for 10: a first-party way to define recurring or cron-style schedules for tasks or workflows, management of those schedules, documentation of scheduled runs in cloud or CLI, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
